terminals.name: next-dev
terminals.description: Next.js 16 (Turbopack) dev server on http://localhost:3000. Supabase and session values are read from environment variables (Cloud Agent Secrets): NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET, JWT_SECRET, PUBLIC_RT_ID, REGISTRATION_RT_ID. The dev server boots without them, but the landing page (/) requires NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL + NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY and returns HTTP 500 if they are unset (getSupabaseServerClient throws on the missing env var); once they are set, per-section fetch failures degrade to a zero-state. /login renders without any secrets. `pnpm run build` also requires the Supabase env vars. Run security suites with `pnpm run test:security:*`.
